name: SafeDollar reward pool deflationary-token accounting
summary: SdoRewardPool credited the nominal PLX deposit and returned that nominal amount even though PLX burned 0.15% on transfer. Repeated deposit/withdraw cycles depleted the pool's actual PLX balance to two wei; updatePool() divided newly accrued SDO by that balance, inflating accSdoPerShare and allowing a pre-positioned stake to mint unbacked SDO.

loss.notes: The campaign's final transaction transfers exactly 202,230.248261 USDC and 46,006.739506 USDT from the two SDO liquidity pools to the attacker helper after the helper sells the unbacked reward SDO. Stablecoins are valued at par.

ageReset.description: The add(500, PLX, 0, 1623470400) calldata installed deflationary PLX 0x7a5dc8a09c831251026302c93a778748dd48b4df as pool 9, changing poolLength() from 9 to 10 and creating the vulnerable code-and-token combination. The operator's only later call before exploitation changed pool 8, not pool 9.

sources.note: Reviewed all three campaign receipts and traces, verified SdoRewardPool source, deployment and configuration transactions, direct runtime history and disassembly, the operator's intervening calls, the official post-mortem, and the commit-pinned reproduction. Anchor 0x55dad44a7ed31d1637e70879af66e02290d39aea54554f8411e6ec19c03a074b is the first defect exercise: the phase-one helper deposits nominal PLX into pool 9 while the fee-on-transfer token delivers less. Transaction 0xd78ff27f33576ff7ece3a58943f3e74caaa9321bcc3238e4cf014eca2e89ce3f later performs the deposit/withdraw loop, and 0x1360315a16aec1c7403d369bd139f0fd55a99578d117cb5637b234a0a0ee5c14 harvests and sells the inflated SDO rewards. SdoRewardPool's 9,243-byte direct runtime hashes to 0xea86fb8ed006040384160d04287f84516648c6ec72248f00c2245fbf16d59a76 at deployment block 15577880 and pre-anchor block 16225171, contains no SELFDESTRUCT, and makes no target-originated DELEGATECALL in the anchor trace. Transaction 0xa246fe2083b7f6bbd3374dd9193afe062df51650173a2551c0cb621ff4744aa3 at 15610160:80, timestamp 1623466022, adds PLX as pool 9; poolLength() changes from 9 to 10 and poolInfo(9) identifies PLX. The operator's only later target call before the anchor is set(8, 40000, 0), so it does not reset pool 9. Code/configuration age is 1,366,744 seconds. The final receipt transfers 202,230.248261 USDC and 46,006.739506 USDT from the SDO pairs to the attacker helper, matching the official report's rounded quantities.
